text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin continues working<n>part-time jobs and
sending money<n>back to her family. It looks like
she's<n>doing her best as the older sister of<n>the
household.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But she's not holding back when it<n>comes to race
prep either. And<n>apparently, her coworkers are
even<n>helping out by letting her adjust her<n>work
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines is determined to do her best.<n>After all, she's
also running for all<n>those who see their hopes and
dreams in her.
